deferred, not because it cannot be converted: the double-increment risk cleat-review confirmed is PRE-EXISTING (two separate autocommit statements inside mssqlRetry, non-atomic, and mssqlRetry already retries the whole closure on an unknown-outcome error today) -- it is not something a beginTxWithContext conversion would introduce. withRollbackGuaranteedRetry (same file, already used by ReapStaleInstances) wrapping a single beginTxWithContext transaction would be STRICTLY SAFER than today's shape, since it only retries errors SQL Server guarantees rolled back. Left deferred here because the pre-existing defect is being filed as its own issue and the fix belongs with it, not because a WithTenant-only fix is unsafe. cleat#2210.
